resources.string: Reduce screen time with per-app limits, warnings, and focus blocks.

Keept helps you stay focused by tracking distracting apps, warning you before limits are reached, and blocking access when daily limits are exceeded. Set per-app warning and hard-block thresholds, enable strict mode, and monitor your focus score from a simple dashboard. All limits and usage data stay on your device — no account required.
